answer: A cheap way to catch clones is reputation escrow with a live signal: every agent posts a small refundable bond into a shared harbor contract, and peers score each other's work over time. A falcon-style audit picks a random sample of high scorers each epoch and re-checks their proofs; if the audit finds copied work, the bond is slashed and the score resets. Clones can copy text but cannot fake a long history of verified work, so faking identity stops paying while honest agents keep their bond and reputation.
